failing_input.input: the observed births shuffled (E1) and one random pair per case (E4), which must land inside their nulls

E2.statistic: mean over cases of J's concentration minus the same case's 3 J + 3 O* concentration

x_axis.stated: The card states 5.93T stage-1 tokens and the stage1-step<N> revision names. It does not state the batch size, the sequence length, the tokens per step, or whether the tokens per step are constant over stage 1 (its table's 65,536 is the context length, its 4096 the hidden size).

gain_over_elsewhere.rule: explore_jo.py: J/O*(t_b)/J/O*(t_b-2) over the median of the case's other two-step gains, entering = valid and mean O* > 0

median.left_out_rule: s(T_15) <= 0 under this scale, or no valid checkpoint with r_J > 0 (b_act undefined)

mean.left_out_rule: s(T_15) <= 0 under this scale, or no valid checkpoint with r_J > 0 (b_act undefined)

global.left_out_rule: s(T_15) <= 0 under this scale, or no valid checkpoint with r_J > 0 (b_act undefined)
